m: Oven to 220°C. Cut the potatoes into wedges, toss with oil, salt and half the oregano and roast 20 minutes.
Meanwhile toss the chicken with the juice and zest of most of the lemons, half the garlic (crushed), the rest of the oregano, oil and salt.
Add the chicken and the red onion wedges to the tray, turn the potatoes, and roast another 20 minutes.
Add the tomatoes and roast 10 minutes more until the chicken is golden and the tomatoes burst.
Tzatziki: grated cucumber (water squeezed out), yoghurt, the rest of the garlic, a squeeze of lemon and salt.
Crumble the fetta over the tray, scatter parsley, and serve with the tzatziki.
l: Everything in one container with the tzatziki on the side.
